comment: The editor's locations (tools/locations.py). Each is in its main building's own frame (x, y across, z up, yards); doodads: model file id, pos, rot quaternion [x, y, z, w], scale. Files are fetched from wago.tools by id at build 12.1.7.70892; nothing of the game is in this file but ids and transforms.

frame.comment: the building's own frame; world (map 0) = origin + Rz(yawDeg) * local

terrain.comment: the map's ground under the yard: root ADT (MCNK MCVT heights) and tex0 (MCLY layers, MCAL alpha), chunks [ix, iy] of the tile, in world coordinates (move with frame); chunks: those whose centre is within 95 yards of the building (the fog ends at 55 from the outside camera, so the ground reaches past it)

light.source: MOHD ambient; the room's light is baked into its vertex colours (MOCV)

fog.source: the map's, as outside: seen through the door (the room is nearer than its start); MFOG is interiorFog
